title: Interface Log: Restart Replays a Release on PF1-27279-L2-A, Pallet D-2291 at Door 12

lines.msg: CHG PFC-IT-48230 window opened; user svc_ifc; stopping service IFC MES>WMS-DAL
IFC MES>WMS-DAL service restart (change ticket PFC-IT-48230, user svc_ifc)
startup: replay directory scan .\ifc\replay\ : 1 file found (HOLDREL_20271011_2215.dat)
queue flush: 3 pending msgs sent to WMS-DAL
WMS-DAL ACK: 3 of 3 msgs accepted
REPLAY file HOLDREL_20271011_2215.dat seq 4471: LOT PF1-27279-L2-A ACTION=RELEASE (routine QA micro release, 10/11 22:15)
WMS-DAL LOT PF1-27279-L2-A STATUS=AVAILABLE/PICKABLE
replay complete: 1 record applied, 0 rejected; service state RUNNING
WMS-DAL event: PICK SCAN pallet D-2291 LOT PF1-27279-L2-A QTY 56 CS -> Cornerstone store route DAL-R07, outbound door 12
WMS-DAL event: LOAD SUSPENDED pallet D-2291 at door 12 by DC supervisor; reason text: 'RED HOLD TAG ON PALLET'
WMS-DAL inquiry: LOT PF1-27279-L2-A STATUS=AVAILABLE/PICKABLE; pallet D-2291 LOC DOOR-12 STAGED
heartbeat WMS-DAL OK; queue depth 0

instructorNote: Hand this out while the SimCell plays the Dallas DC manager's call: "Your interface just un-held one of your lots on my screen. The pallet is at door 12, out of the cooler, and the WMS still says AVAILABLE. Do I trust the screen or the tag? And this costs me the people who were counting the 3,000." Watch for LOG to send D-2291 back to the 34–38°F quarantine cooler, re-tag it, treat the tag as the hold of record and log time out of the cooler. Watch for TRACE to re-apply the MES hold, confirm WMS-DAL shows HOLD within 10 minutes, have IT block unreviewed replay files, add the event to the Gaps tab and tell RECALL that the Dallas physical count is still not confirmed.
